subject: [RFC PATCH 10/18] mm/filemap: mark a folio accessed in one place in filemap_read()

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the filemap_read() function by removing duplicate calls to folio_mark_accessed(). It introduces a new helper function, filemap_read_accessed(), which marks a folio as accessed in one place. This change is intended to prepare for future decisions on which folios are worth reading without a reference. The patch does not alter the behavior of the filemap_read() function and only makes minor changes to its implementation.
